استغنوا (form X)
# اِسْتَغْنَوْا (istaḡnaw) /is.taɣ.naw/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَغْنَى (istaḡnā)
# اُسْتُغْنُوا (ustuḡnū) /us.tuɣ.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَغْنَى (istaḡnā)
# اِسْتَغْنُوا (istaḡnū) /is.taɣ.nuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَغْنَى (istaḡnā)
